l.i: ORDO SEV METHODVS QVAE SERVATVR INLECTIONE CA-pitum Biblicorum in collegio Bernensi, ma-tutinis & vespertinis horis, &c.

main_text.l: 1. Coherentiæ & series omnium librorum, tum totius corporis Biblici, tum singularum eius classium ostenditur, vna cum prolegomenis generalibus.
2. Singulorum librorum prolegomena necessaria, hoc est isagogica, præmittuntur analysi generali.
3. Synopses singulorum librorum, in quibus series & connexio omnium capitum, ob oculos ponitur.
4. Summa uniuscuiusque capitis seu primaria eius propositio ostenditur.
5. Summa capitis si prolixior fit & multi-plex, tum partes eius singulæ indicantur, & cu-jusque partis propositio.
6. Partium item ex toto distributarum subdiuisiones non omittuntur.
7. Loca quædam obscuriora explicantur, in elucidatione Hebraismi vel Hellenismi alicuius, siue in Tropi & Figuræ insignioris enucleatione.
8. Αντ[?]λογιῶν φαινομένων[?], hoc est, Apparentium contradictionum conciliatio instituitur.
9. Testimonia quædam illustria Orthodoxam fidem demonstrantia notantur & applicantur.

page.notes: The Greek in item 8 is printed as Αντλογιῶν φαινομένων, probably for ἀντιλογιῶν; the second letters are doubtful, so the word is marked [?]. The "8." carries a small smudge that is not text. The left-hand strip shows the edge of the facing page, which was left out. The line at the foot of the page is cut off by the scan edge only in its last words; nothing else is missing.
